purpose: Qualitative demand/friction intelligence for the single Stödassistenten learning system. Scores are ordinal discovery priorities, not measured search volumes or eligibility evidence. VAB rules are truth-bearing only after current primary-source verification; discovery material is never used as fact.

scoring.priority_rule: Prioritize combinations of high demand, high friction, high consequence and weak current product coverage. These scores guide eval, retrieval and question-order work only.

natural_language_queries: mitt barn är 13 kan jag vabba när barnet blir sämre
har jag fortfarande 90 dagar på mig att söka vab
behöver jag läkarintyg första dagen när barnet är över 12
vad är förhandsbeslut vab och behöver jag det

demand_signal.basis: VAB is a broad parent-facing social-insurance route, and the application deadline changed nationally on 1 April 2026. The score is a qualitative product-priority signal, not measured query volume.

friction_signal.basis: Users must distinguish the new 30-day deadline from the previous 90-day rule while also understanding that age 12-15 introduces special-care/supervision and documentation conditions that differ from ordinary VAB for younger children.

miss_consequence.basis: Following the old deadline can cause a late application, while treating age 12-15 as ordinary automatic VAB can produce a false-positive recommendation or missing medical documentation.

source_fragmentation.basis: The current rule is spread across Försäkringskassan pages for age 12+ VAB, medical statements/prior decisions and the 2026 application-deadline change.

language_accessibility_friction.basis: Terms such as särskilt behov av vård eller tillsyn, läkarutlåtande, intyg and förhandsbeslut are easy to conflate, especially under time pressure or with limited Swedish/digital familiarity.

steps_to_action.basis: A safe answer needs only a few high-value facts: first absence date, child age, reason/special care need, whether a prior decision exists and whether required medical documentation is available.

recurrence_signal.basis: The 2026 deadline change affects new VAB periods nationally, while age-based documentation rules are a stable recurring boundary in Försäkringskassan guidance. This is not a measured frequency claim.

current_product_coverage_gap.basis: The scenario library covered several family and work-benefit areas but lacked a permanent regression combining the post-1-April-2026 deadline with the age-12-plus documentation boundary.

signals.recommended_learning_action: Add a fail-closed synthetic regression that distinguishes age 12-15 from ordinary younger-child VAB, asks whether a prior decision exists, preserves medical-documentation requirements and surfaces the current 30-day application window before older 90-day habits can mislead the user.
signals.truth_rule: Verify the current application deadline, age boundary, documentation requirement and any exception against Försäkringskassan; do not infer VAB eligibility from diagnosis, child age or an old 90-day rule alone.
